hunks.assessment: One new named behavior, Promise gate around real /api/events requests, including native replacement caused by explicit Session creation. No route.fulfill, model rewrite, EventSource substitute or focus injection.
Read-only observations capture activeElement, visibility/layout, page mount and selection. Diagnostics do not decide or fabricate product state. DOM references agree with existing shell contract.

Drive original UI creation, fill and selection; assert pre-mount editing, release actual state, wait visible Inbox and real narrow layout, verify operability/focus/selection/value and return-wide preference. Assertions preserve existing user invariants and add a deterministic timing boundary for the independently observed regression. Original shell.spec.js remains byte-identical.
Finally releases all pending routes on success/failure. Playwright owns fresh page and context lifetime; test registers no process or shared state.

heuristic_specific_judgment.Duplicated Code: Some original breakpoint setup is intentionally repeated to preserve an independent controlled startup regression; extracting a generic interaction harness would hide the timing boundary without demonstrated maintenance harm.
heuristic_specific_judgment.Message Chains: Playwright locator chains and read-only DOM inspection are intentional test observation boundaries, not new product dependencies.
heuristic_specific_judgment.Speculative Generality: No generic hooks or production abstractions added; one demonstrated failure mode has one regression test.

evidence_limits: Original cloud failure had no activeElement instrumentation; attribution is supported by separately labeled local controlled reproductions, not direct cloud causal observation.

Trace does not contain served JavaScript response bodies. Exact Git exports, fixture sys.path, selected server configs and network URLs bind the tested service sources; no claim of independently hashed served JS body.
No new reviewer browser tests or broad source/AC verification; applicable existing owner runs and independent r7 review reused.
